snippet.title: A drawing game where BAD drawings can win 😭 (Grand Canvas trailer)
snippet.description:
Can you draw? Doesn't matter. In Grand Canvas a potato in a tie can beat a masterpiece. 🥔👔

Grand Canvas is a free multiplayer drawing party game for Android. Everyone draws the same prompt against the clock, then the room backs their favourite drawing with in-game coins (Grand). Pick the winner, climb the weekly leaderboard, and throw tomatoes at the worst drawing. 🍅

If you like skribbl.io or Gartic Phone, try this one with your friends.

▶️ Play free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whosegames.grandcanvas

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✏️ DRAW IT
• One prompt, two minutes, any answer: "Every office has an ongoing problem"
• Players fill in each other's blanks, so no two rounds are the same
• 8 pens (marker, crayon, pencil, brush, ink, neon, rainbow, spray) and 7 papers (graph, ruled, kraft, sticky notes, parchment, canvas…)
• Steady Hand, Mirror, Paint Bucket and Living Lines (your drawing wobbles and breathes)
• 50 stickers to slap onto your drawing, up to 5 per drawing

💰 BACK IT
• Every seat gets 1,000 Grand coins to spend across the other players' drawings
• A drawing is FUNDED at 300 Grand
• Back the top two drawings and you earn bonus coins
• Watch the money fly onto each drawing in the big reveal

🍅 HECKLE IT — EMOTES
• Throw things at drawings during the reveal: Tomato, Egg, Cream Pie, Slime, Rose, Confetti
• Or send a Thumbs Down 👎, a Clown 🤡, a Yawn 🥱 or a Skull 💀
• Every emote has its own animation and sound, and the drawing shakes when hit
• 100% anonymous: nobody ever knows who threw the tomato
• 3 per game, so it stays funny and never turns into spam
• 🏅 MOST PELTED: the most heckled drawing gets its own badge at the end

🏆 WIN IT
• Gold and silver podium, trophies and Grand payouts
• Weekly leaderboard with leagues and rankings
• Ranked matchmaking against players everywhere

🐉 WHOSE?DRAGON — your 3D pet
• A real 3D baby dragon that lives in your phone
• Draw his food and he eats it. Colour inside the lines… or scribble and see what happens 😤
• Draw his clothes and he wears them
• Feed him for 30 days and he grows up
• Waves, dances, naps, breathes fire and does loop-the-loops

👯 PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Private rooms with a code, and you choose the rounds and the timer
• Emotes are FREE at a friendly table
• Add bots if you're short on players
• Friends list, invites and player cards

🖼️ YOUR GALLERY & THE DAILY
• Every drawing you make is kept in your vault
• Make a montage of your month
• The Daily: one prompt for the whole world each day, and hearts earn you Grand

🛍️ THE GRAND SHOP
• Pens, papers, tools, the full colour palette, stickers and emotes
• Grand is WON, never sold: daily gifts, Daily hearts and ranked wins

👑 GRAND PASS
• No ads, every colour and pen, Steady Hand, your gallery kept safe, and a crown by your name
• ₹150, once, for good
• Or earn it free: 3 friends use your code = 30 days of Grand Pass 🎁

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📱 Android phones and tablets
🆓 Free to play
🌍 Play with anyone, anywhere

📬 CONTACT & LINKS
🌐 Website: https://grandcanvas.duckdns.org
✉️ Email: gameswhose@gmail.com
▶️ Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whosegames.grandcanvas
